about: Clairic's replies from live probes of @cf/cloudflare/clairic on 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-25, one case per request: the HTTP status and the reply body byte for byte (no headers), the number of fields the request sent, and, where a test or the conformance suite sends the same request again, the state and the fields as role fields (sent). The b-probes also carry their original request bodies byte for byte. Each body is read with provider::read_reply and becomes item, the item a module answers with: a success forwards the answers (number text, spans and unknown members untouched), truncated, state_text and usage; an error maps by Workers AI code, then by status (5006 at HTTP 400 and 3030 at HTTP 422 are not in the table, so both are invalid_item), with the status, code and the provider's message in the item error's message. No error reply carries usage. Every measured success bills the schema once and the state and images once per model call; the reported passes is not the number of model calls.
